experiments.name: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR backscatter features
experiments.conclusion: C-band SAR (5.6cm wavelength) scatters off canopy top, does not penetrate to ground. Only 1.3% RMSE improvement. L-band needed for forest penetration.

experiments.name: CHMv2 canopy height as ML feature
experiments.conclusion: CHMv2 as-feature adds only 0.5% improvement. Coverage 98.8% vs CHMv1 41.4%. Combined v1+v2 gives best result.

experiments.name: CHMv2 creative: direct subtraction + sub-pixel + texture
experiments.conclusion: Direct CHMv2 subtraction HURTS (-3.4%). 10m CHMv2 introduces noise vs 8m DSM. Baseline model already learned canopy corrections implicitly.

experiments.name: Validate 8m DTM against HMA2 2m DEMs for glacier regions
experiments.conclusion: HMA2 2m DEMs provide highest-quality validation for glacier zones. Coverage is small (~6 glaciers) but resolution is 4x our product.

experiments.name: Survey Department contours and rivers as spatial features
experiments.conclusion: contour_river 9.442 m RMSE vs baseline 9.707 m (+2.7%) on spatial-block holdout against altimetry, only at points within 500 m of a parsed contour. The contour download is truncated mid-file, so this is not a national test. A model trained with those contours cannot also cite them as an independent check. At 41 named-summit coordinates the 8 m DTM is -170.6 m from the labelled height on average; several summits are hundreds of metres off, so those coordinates are not a clean height check.

experiments.name: Terrace edges and river water from fine open imagery
experiments.conclusion: Trishuli 6 cm ortho, pass holdout, n=568: terrace features 5.167 m vs baseline 5.084 m (-1.6%). Not a national score. Shadow length was not converted to metres (acquisition date 2025-09-03, no clock time). Kathmandu 2.5 m 4-band tile: surveyed river vertices are darker in every band, but the bright infrared band stays above green there, so open water could not be separated and no width was measured.

experiments.name: Natural lands mask for stratified DTM correction
experiments.conclusion: Proxy natural-lands features tested. Next: download actual WRI Natural Lands Map for ground truth classification.

experiments.name: Snow melt timing from Sentinel-2 SCL as elevation proxy
experiments.conclusion: Physics-based snow proxy (elevation+aspect+slope) tested as feature. Next step: download actual Sentinel-2 SCL time series for real melt dates.

experiments.name: Phenology gradient (NDVI green-up timing) as elevation proxy
experiments.conclusion: Physics-based phenology proxy tested. Next: real Sentinel-2 NDVI time series for actual green-up dates.

experiments.name: Soil organic carbon density as terrain position proxy
experiments.conclusion: Terrain-based SOC proxy tested. Next: download actual OpenLandMap SOC rasters from STAC.

experiments.name: Interferometric SAR elevation correction
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. fusion/data/nw/sar holds OPERA RTC backscatter for three areas, not Sentinel-1 SLC pairs. EXP001 already scored that backscatter. Phase-to-height needs the single-look complex data.

experiments.name: Land surface temperature lapse rate
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. No Landsat 8/9 Band 10 scene is on disk. A temperature proxy built from elevation would repeat the DSM feature.

experiments.name: Agricultural field boundaries as a flatness prior
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. No Trazo/FTW field-boundary layer is on disk. WorldCover cropland (class 40) is already in the baseline features.

experiments.name: Shadow-derived height differences
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. EXP006 could not convert Trishuli shadows to metres (acquisition date 2025-09-03, no clock time). No national Sentinel-2 scene with sun elevation is on disk.

experiments.name: Atmospheric water vapor column
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. No Sentinel-2 B8A/B9 water-vapour raster is on disk.

experiments.name: Aerosol optical depth as a valley proxy
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. No MAIAC aerosol raster is on disk. At 1 km it is also coarser than the 8 m and 30 m surfaces already in the model.

experiments.name: L-band SAR canopy penetration
experiments.conclusion: Blocked. No PALSAR-2 or NISAR interferometric DEM is on disk. NISAR HH/HV brightness was already added to the correction model and the forest error stayed at 2.13 m versus 2.14 m.

experiments.name: GEDI footprints added to ICESat-2 training
experiments.conclusion: Scored on 6,230,548 ICESat-2 points only. Training on ICESat-2 alone: 5.402 m. Training on ICESat-2 plus GEDI: 5.616 m. Adding GEDI made the ICESat-2 error worse. This is not the national 13.3 million point score.

experiments.name: Downhill enforcement along surveyed rivers
experiments.conclusion: On 2,154,423 laser points within 200 m of a surveyed river, the out-of-fold model was 8.179 m. Forcing the predicted ground to fall monotonically along the river raised that error to 34.168 m. Rivers have no height, so the downhill direction was taken from the surface itself.

experiments.name: Snow proxy stacked with green-up proxy
experiments.conclusion: Same physics proxies as EXP008 and EXP009, stacked. Not Sentinel-2 snow dates or NDVI.

experiments.name: Separate models for forest, cropland, and other land
experiments.conclusion: Separate HistGBR models for WorldCover forest, cropland, and other land, scored on the same spatial blocks as one national model. This is WorldCover, not the WRI Natural Lands map.

experiments.name: CHMv2 plus contour and river features
experiments.conclusion: CHMv2 (the EXP002 feature) stacked with the EXP005 contour and river features, on the full laser set. Missing canopy stays missing. The contour download is still truncated, so the contour columns are only informative near the parsed sheets.

experiments.name: Langtang Lirung 2 m and HMA 8 m v2 composites (Zenodo 22842748)
experiments.conclusion: Gated 2 m composite on our 8 m grid (1,228,353 cells): our DEM 6.69 m RMSE, median +1.62 m (n=979,936); our DTM 7.13 m RMSE, median -2.44 m (n=979,936); Copernicus 11.92 m RMSE, median +0.62 m (n=979,936). Laser points in the 8 m v2 footprint: v2 13.14 m RMSE, median +3.97 m (n=151,981), our DTM held-out 9.37 m RMSE, median +0.90 m (n=151,981). Adding v2 NMAD, count and v2-minus-DSM (spatial block holdout): 7.563 m vs 7.939 m (+4.7%). Local footprint, not a national score; avalanche track not masked.

experiments.name: Self-supervised DEM super-resolution 8 m -> 2 m
experiments.conclusion: Stage 1 (32->8 m, 48 unseen tiles): SSL 1.889 m vs bicubic 2.247 m (-16%). Pure 8->2 m SR from the reference's own 8 m average: NMAD bicubic 0.291 -> SSL 0.165 m (Langtang east), 0.359 -> 0.228 m (Chamoli); RMSE unchanged (~0.58 and 1.10 m). From our 8 m DEM the debiased RMSE stays 6.83 m (bicubic) vs 6.86 m (SSL): the 8 m product error dominates. Fine-tuning on Langtang west did not help. No MAE pre-training.

experiments.name: Nepal pipeline transferred to Chamoli, scored at 2 m (Zenodo 4554647)
experiments.conclusion: Nepal-trained pipeline run unchanged on 4 tiles over Chamoli, scored against the 2015 2 m composite (5,857,675 cells of 8 m, count>=2, NMAD<3 m): our DEM 9.22 m RMSE, median -0.39 m; our DTM 11.68 m RMSE, median -5.33 m; Copernicus 14.47 m RMSE, median -2.86 m. The composite was co-registered to the HMA 8 m mosaic, so DEM agreement is partly built in. Outside Nepal; not a national score.

experiments.name: HMA strip count and agreement as national features
experiments.conclusion: Strip count, NMAD, median-minus-DSM and time span from the 513 NSIDC HMA 8 m strips over Nepal, sampled at every laser point (48.3% of points have at least one strip). Same spatial blocks as EXP022.

experiments.name: Joint strip adjustment vs ICESat-2 photons (Langtang gate)
experiments.conclusion: Langtang gate, 26 strips, 1,262,003 photon ties, 698,737 overlap ties. Gated 2 m (1,186,973 cells): current 8.41 m RMSE, NMAD 1.28, median +1.60 (n=1,186,973); raw median 6.23 m RMSE, NMAD 1.20, median +1.79 (n=1,186,973); adjusted 5.88 m RMSE, NMAD 0.92, median -0.40 (n=1,186,973). Held-out photons on open ground: current 4.03 m RMSE, NMAD 1.40, median +2.35 (n=55,975); adjusted 2.61 m RMSE, NMAD 1.15, median +0.20 (n=55,975). Gate PASSED.

experiments.name: Smooth per-strip correction surfaces (Langtang gate)
experiments.conclusion: Langtang, 26 strips. Gated 2 m: plane 5.88 m RMSE, NMAD 0.92, median -0.40 (n=1,186,973); grid_4km 6.00 m RMSE, NMAD 1.14, median -1.08 (n=1,186,973). Held-out photons, open ground: plane 2.61 m RMSE, NMAD 1.15, median +0.20 (n=55,975); grid_4km 2.59 m RMSE, NMAD 1.18, median +0.27 (n=55,975). Gate FAILED (grid must beat plane on both).

experiments.name: 8 m photon-cell training targets vs ATL08
experiments.conclusion: Scored on held-out-track 8 m photon cells in held-out 48 km blocks: ATL08-trained RMSE 4.14 m (tree 5.78); both-trained 4.11 m (tree 5.76), +0.7%. On held-out ATL08 points: 5.50 vs 5.53 m. Keep ATL08 targets.

experiments.name: Void filling for cells without HMA stereo
experiments.conclusion: Langtang void cells (no accepted HMA stereo): current Copernicus fill 32.72 m RMSE vs 2 m reference; best D_strips_kept 14.25 m. Held-out photons in voids: 77.30 vs 66.43 m. ADOPT.

experiments.name: DTM = DEM on bare ground
experiments.conclusion: [v2 before EXP030] Langtang DTM 8.88 -> guard_bare 9.34 m (guard_nontree 9.35, DEM 8.67); Khumbu wind tower 7.63 -> 1.19 m. Reject. CORRECTION: Langtang 2 m is a stereo DSM (canopy top), invalid for judging a DTM; on bare-ground dGPS the guard fixes the DTM (wind tower 7.63->1.19, glacier surface 6.15->2.52 m). Decide on held-out ICESat-2 ground photons by land cover after the EXP030 rebuild. PHOTON DECISION: on 19.8 M held-out ATL03 ground photons the rule is worse: all 5.26 -> 5.81 m, bare/snow (8.9 M) 6.52 -> 7.49 m. The Khumbu dGPS gain is local (debris-covered glacier). REJECTED; DTM kept as is.

experiments.name: Multi-baseline Sentinel-1 InSAR height correction
experiments.conclusion: Sentinel-1 multi-baseline stack at Langtang: on v2 Copernicus-fill cells against the 2 m composite Copernicus 12.70 m -> 12.69 m with the InSAR height correction (+0.1%). Gate (>=10%) FAILED.
